note: Every source of the shipped medical lexicon, checked per Addendum K0.5 before it is used: the licence must allow commercial redistribution inside the product (no non-commercial terms, no AGPL, no per-user licence such as the UMLS terms, nothing paid). A source that fails, or whose file no longer matches its pinned sha256, is refused and its terms are not used; it is replaced, never used for now. Excluded on purpose: DrugBank open data (CC BY-NC) and RxNorm/UMLS content under the UMLS licence.
